energy.name: Opener
energy.description: The quietest end of its genre: sparse, long intro, little tension. Opens a set or resets the room.

energy.name: Warm-up
energy.description: Steady and rolling, below the genre's usual drive. Holds a floor without asking for a reaction.

energy.name: Workhorse
energy.description: The genre's normal full groove. Keeps a floor moving without a big moment.

energy.name: Lift
energy.description: Above the genre's norm: a bigger drop, riff, vocal or build. Raises the room.

energy.name: Peak weapon
energy.description: The genre's most intense: anthem hooks, the biggest drops. The moment of the night for that sound.

genres.name: Ambient / Experimental
genres.definition: Beatless or barely-there rhythm: texture, drones and space rather than groove.

genres.name: Downtempo
genres.definition: Slow, head-nodding beats with warm textures, from trip hop to chillout.

genres.name: Electronica
genres.definition: Listening-first electronic music with detailed, often broken or glitchy rhythms.

genres.name: Organic House
genres.definition: Unhurried house built on hand percussion, acoustic instruments and earthy, desert-tinged melody.
references: Nu feat. Jo.Ke – Who Loves the Sun (2)

genres.name: Afro House
genres.definition: House driven by African percussion, chants and polyrhythm, from tribal to melodic.
references: Adam Port & Stryv feat. Malachiii – Move (5)

genres.name: Amapiano
genres.definition: South African house with log-drum basslines, jazzy keys and shuffling, sparse drums.
references: Uncle Waffles & Tony Duardo feat. Sino Msolo & BoiBizza – Tanzania (5)

genres.name: Latin Electronic
genres.definition: Club music built on Latin rhythms: guaracha, moombahton, electronic cumbia, raptor house.
references: 3Ball MTY feat. América Sierra & El Bebeto – Inténtalo (4)
Dillon Francis & Diplo feat. Maluca – Que Que (5)

genres.name: Brazilian Funk
genres.definition: Baile funk from Rio and São Paulo: tamborzão and beatbox drums, chopped vocals, heavy bass.
references: MC Fioti – Bum Bum Tam Tam (4)
MC Kevin o Chris feat. FP do Trem Bala – Vamos pra Gaiola (5)

genres.name: Deep House
genres.definition: Warm, soulful house with rich chords, round bass and restraint over impact.
references: Mr. Fingers – Can You Feel It (2)

genres.name: House
genres.definition: The four-to-the-floor core: piano, vocals and grooves from Chicago and New York onward.
references: Robin S – Show Me Love (Stonebridge Remix) (5)

genres.name: Nu Disco / Disco
genres.definition: Disco and its modern descendants: live bass, strings, filtered loops and edits.
references: Breakbot feat. Irfane – Baby I'm Yours (3)

genres.name: Funky House
genres.definition: Upbeat, sample-heavy house with funk and disco loops, horns and big vocal hooks.
references: Stardust – Music Sounds Better With You (5)

genres.name: Jackin House
genres.definition: Bouncy, swung, bass-forward house made to jack to, with chopped vocal samples.
references: Waze & Odyssey vs R. Kelly – Bump & Grind 2014 (3)

genres.name: Progressive House
genres.definition: Long, evolving house that builds through layered melody and patient arrangement.

genres.name: Melodic House & Techno
genres.definition: Emotive, synth-led house and techno: arpeggios, big pads, dark or euphoric melody.

genres.name: Indie Dance
genres.definition: Dance music with an indie and post-punk edge: live-sounding bass, dark disco, synth-pop.
references: Röyksopp – What Else Is There? (Trentemøller Remix) (2)

genres.name: Stutter House
genres.definition: Wistful, filtered house with stuttering, chopped vocal loops and a nostalgic haze.
references: Fred again.. & The Blessed Madonna – Marea (We've Lost Dancing) (3)
Fred again.. & Swedish House Mafia feat. Future – Turn On the Lights again.. (4)

genres.name: Minimal / Deep Tech
genres.definition: Stripped, groove-first house and techno: clicks, micro-edits and rolling basslines.

genres.name: Tech House
genres.definition: House groove with techno's punch: tight drums, rolling bass and hooky vocal cuts.

genres.name: Indie Tech
genres.definition: Indie dance's heavier, glossier cousin: punchy drums, bold synth hooks, festival weight.

genres.name: Bass House
genres.definition: House with bassline and dubstep weight: wobbling, growling bass under a 4/4 groove.

genres.name: UK Garage / Bassline
genres.definition: Shuffled, swung UK club music: 2-step skips, chopped vocals, speed garage and bassline.
references: Artful Dodger feat. Craig David – Re-Rewind (5)

genres.name: Breaks / Breakbeat / UK Bass
genres.definition: Broken, sampled drum breaks instead of a straight kick, from big beat to UK bass.
references: Fatboy Slim – Right Here, Right Now (4)
The Chemical Brothers – Block Rockin' Beats (5)

genres.name: Electro
genres.definition: Robotic, syncopated 808 drums and sci-fi synths, from Detroit and Miami bass onward.

genres.name: Bass / Club
genres.definition: Regional club styles built on chopped samples and kicks: Jersey, Baltimore, footwork, ghettotech.
references: DJ Rashad feat. Spinn & Taso – Feelin (2)
Rod Lee – Dance My Pain Away (3)
Cookiee Kawaii – Vibe (If I Back It Up) (4)

genres.name: Raw / Deep / Hypnotic Techno
genres.definition: Techno that works by repetition: hypnotic loops, dub space, rough and deep textures.

genres.name: Peak Time / Driving Techno
genres.definition: Big-room techno: driving kicks, tension and release, built for the main floor.
references: Adam Beyer & Bart Skils – Your Mind (5)

genres.name: Hard Techno
genres.definition: Fast, distorted, relentless techno: industrial kicks, schranz loops, rave stabs.
references: Marco Leckbert – Schranz Will Never Die (4)

genres.name: Raw / Deep / Hypnotic Trance
genres.definition: Underground trance: rolling, hypnotic and dark, closer to techno than to anthems.
references: Age of Love – The Age of Love (Jam & Spoon Watch Out for Stella Mix) (3)

genres.name: Main Floor Trance
genres.definition: Euphoric, melodic trance: long breakdowns, supersaw leads and big vocal anthems.
references: Paul van Dyk – For an Angel (5)

genres.name: Psy-Trance
genres.definition: Psychedelic trance: rolling 16th-note basslines, twisting acid and alien sound design.

genres.name: Hard Dance / Hardcore / Neo Rave
genres.definition: The hard end: hardstyle's reverse bass, hardcore and gabber kicks, uptempo, neo rave.
references: Paul Elstak – Rainbow in the Sky (3)

genres.name: 140 / Deep Dubstep / Grime
genres.definition: Dark, spacious 140: sub-bass pressure and half-time drums, plus grime's MC-led energy.

genres.name: Dubstep
genres.definition: Half-time drops with aggressive, designed bass: brostep, riddim, tearout, melodic.
references: Flight Facilities feat. Giselle – Crave You (Adventure Club Remix) (2)
Skrillex – Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites (5)

genres.name: Trap / Future Bass
genres.definition: EDM trap's 808s and hi-hat rolls, and future bass's lush, pitch-bent supersaw chords.
references: Flume feat. Kai – Never Be Like You (3)

genres.name: Drum & Bass
genres.definition: Fast breakbeats over heavy sub-bass, from liquid and rollers to jump-up, neuro and jungle.

genres.name: Dance / Pop
genres.definition: Radio-ready dance music: pop songs over club beats, slap house, eurodance.

genres.name: Mainstage
genres.definition: Festival EDM: big room drops, electro house leads, future house and future rave.
references: Swedish House Mafia – Don't You Worry Child (4)

genres.name: Hip-Hop
genres.definition: Rap and its production styles, old school to drill. A club track with rapping keeps its club genre and gets #rap instead.
references: Missy Elliott – Get Ur Freak On (5)

genres.name: R&B
genres.definition: Contemporary rhythm and blues: smooth vocals over hip-hop and pop production.
references: Usher feat. Lil Jon & Ludacris – Yeah! (5)

genres.name: Pop
genres.definition: Mainstream pop songs, from the charts and the singalong canon.
references: Whitney Houston – I Wanna Dance with Somebody (Who Loves Me) (5)

genres.name: Latin
genres.definition: Latin American song and dance music: reggaeton, bachata, salsa, cumbia, merengue, dembow.

genres.name: Caribbean
genres.definition: Island music for the dance: dancehall, soca and reggae.
references: Bob Marley & The Wailers – Could You Be Loved (3)

genres.name: African
genres.definition: Popular music from across Africa: Afrobeats, afropop, afroswing, highlife.

genres.name: Country
genres.definition: Country songs, from line-dance staples to country pop.
references: Billy Ray Cyrus – Achy Breaky Heart (4)
Shania Twain – Man! I Feel Like a Woman! (5)

genres.name: Rock
genres.definition: Guitar-band rock, from classic rock to punk and metal.
references: Bon Jovi – Livin' on a Prayer (4)

genres.name: Funk / Soul
genres.definition: Soul, funk and their descendants: Motown, boogie and neo soul.
references: James Brown – Get Up (I Feel Like Being a) Sex Machine (5)

genres.name: Indie / Alternative
genres.definition: Indie and alternative rock and pop: the indie-disco and Britpop singalong canon.

genres.name: K-Pop / J-Pop
genres.definition: East Asian pop: K-pop, J-pop, C-pop and Mandopop.

genres.name: South Asian
genres.definition: Music from South Asia and its diaspora: Bollywood and filmi songs, bhangra, desi hip-hop.
references: Panjabi MC – Mundian To Bach Ke (4)

genres.name: Arabic / Middle Eastern
genres.definition: Pop and party music from the Arab world, North Africa and Turkey: Arab pop, khaliji, raï, mahraganat.

genres.name: Jazz
genres.definition: Jazz for listening, dinner and dancing: vocal, smooth, acid and nu jazz.
references: The Dave Brubeck Quartet – Take Five (2)

genres.name: Gospel
genres.definition: Gospel and contemporary Christian music.
references: Marvin Sapp – Never Would Have Made It (2)
The Edwin Hawkins Singers – Oh Happy Day (3)

genres.name: Classical / Soundtrack
genres.definition: Classical, modern classical and film scores: ceremonies, entrances, intros.

genres.name: World / Folk
genres.definition: Folk and regional party music the other genres don't cover: schlager, Balkan, polka.
references: Helene Fischer – Atemlos durch die Nacht (5)

genres.name: DJ Tools
genres.definition: Material with no genre of its own: battle tools, loops, FX and sound beds. A drum loop that belongs to a genre gets that genre and the #tool label instead, and an edit or acapella keeps its genre and gets #edit or #acapella.

labels.name: Vocal
labels.description: A lead vocal or a vocal hook carries the track.

labels.name: Instrumental
labels.description: No lead vocal. Short vocal samples are fine.

labels.name: Acapella
labels.description: Vocal only, for layering over another track.

labels.name: DJ tool
labels.description: Made for mixing rather than playing on its own: loops, drum tracks, intros, FX.

labels.name: Edit
labels.description: A DJ edit, bootleg or rework of another track.

labels.name: Rap
labels.description: Has rapping or MC vocals, in any genre.

labels.name: Clean
labels.description: No explicit lyrics, or a radio edit.
